Class Waiter

java.lang.Object
entity.Staff
entity.Waiter
public class Waiter extends Staff
The Waiter: each turn, seats one customer, takes one order, serves one READY dish, or waits.

Every action follows the same three steps:

  1. Check every rule. If one fails, throw InvalidActionException and change nothing, so the turn is not used up.
  2. Do the action.
  3. Call markActed().

The Waiter does not need to check whether a dish became READY this turn: the GameController runs the Waiter before the Chef, so any order that is READY when the Waiter acts was finished on an earlier turn.

    • seat

      public void seat(Restaurant restaurant, Customer customer, Table table) throws InvalidActionException
      Seats a queued customer at a free table. The seating itself goes through Restaurant.seat(Customer, Table).
      Parameters:
      restaurant - the restaurant that owns the queue and the tables
      customer - the queued customer to seat
      table - the table to seat them at
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the Waiter has already acted, or the seating breaks a rule

    • takeOrder

      public void takeOrder(Customer customer, Order order) throws InvalidActionException
      Takes a seated customer's order. The GameController builds the Order (choosing the dish and locking the price), so the Waiter never deals with prices.
      Parameters:
      customer - the seated customer
      order - the order with its price already locked
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the Waiter has already acted, or the customer is not SEATED

    • serve

      public void serve(Customer customer, int turn) throws InvalidActionException
      Serves a customer whose order is READY.
      Parameters:
      customer - the customer to serve
      turn - the current turn, recorded so the customer finishes eating next turn
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the Waiter has already acted, the customer has no order, or the order is not READY
